settings.whatsapp_message: Hi MG Car Audio, I'd like to book a fitting. My reg is:

settings.title: Send your reg and a dash photo
settings.text: WhatsApp us your reg and a photo of your dash, or use the quote form. That's usually all we need to tell you what fits.

settings.title: Get a fixed price
settings.text: You get one fitted price for parts and labour before you commit, so there are no surprises on the day.

settings.title: Pay the €50 deposit
settings.text: The €50 deposit secures your slot at our Ballymount workshop and comes off your final bill.

settings.title: Drive in, drive away
settings.text: We fit it, test everything with your phone and show you how it works. The balance is paid when the work is done.

settings.heading: How booking works
settings.text: No app to download and no account to create. Tell us about your car, agree the price, then pay the deposit online.

settings.heading: Book one of these online
settings.footnote: Something else? Send us your reg and we'll come back with a price and a time.

settings.question: Why do I need to pay a deposit?
settings.answer: The €50 deposit confirms your booking, reserves workshop time for your car and lets us have any parts ready. It's taken off your final bill on the day.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my booking?
settings.answer: Yes. Contact us at least 48 hours before your appointment and we'll move your deposit to a new date. Deposits are non-refundable if you don't attend, or if you cancel with less than 48 hours' notice.

settings.question: What do you need from me to give a price?
settings.answer: Your registration number, a photo of your dash and screen, and what you'd like done. WhatsApp is quickest, or use our quote form.

settings.question: How long will my car be with you?
settings.answer: Most CarPlay and Android Auto fittings take one to two hours. BMW Android Auto on iDrive 7 takes about an hour, an Android radio fitting about an hour and a half, and a BMW Japan-to-Europe conversion about two hours. We'll confirm the time when you book.

settings.question: Can I bring my own radio for you to fit?
settings.answer: Yes. Our Android radio fitting is €150 when you supply the radio, fascia kit and harness. For CarPlay interfaces and screen upgrades we recommend buying the parts through us, so we can check they suit your car and stand over the whole job.

settings.question: When do I pay the rest?
settings.answer: The balance is paid in the workshop once the work is done and you've seen everything working.
